Detailed Description

Prefab parameters for a rod actor.

Extends RodActorParams. The inherited RodActorParams::worldFromLocal is replaced by the prefab-relative rotation and translation fields, and the inherited RodActorParams::shape (a runtime ShapeHandle) is replaced by shapeFile (a path serialized to JSON. The shape is loaded at instantiation time).

Note
The rod is created in its rest configuration, then pose is applied if set. Use Actor::SetRecenteringParams after instantiation to change recentering.
The inherited RodActorParams::name field need not be unique, but a name shared by more than one actor cannot be used by name-based prefab references.

◆ scale

Real3 superdex::prefab::RodActorPrefab::scale {1_r, 1_r, 1_r}

Scale [x, y, z] to bake into the shape file.

Applies to the rod geometry: node positions, element frame axes (transformed by the inverse transpose and renormalized), and the visual and contact-skin meshes. Also applies to PointCloudColliderParams::radius, which is authored for the unscaled shape and is multiplied by the absolute value of the uniform scale. Does not apply to RodActorParams::material, RodActorParams::contact, or the other RodActorParams::pointCloudCollider parameters.

Note
All components must be non-zero and finite. Negative components mirror the corresponding model-space axes.
Must be uniform by absolute value when the rod has a point-cloud collider (see RodActorParams::colliderType).
